comments.body:
Hi fellow sailors. Where should I fish in order to catch tons of tuna?
::Thanks::

comments.author: Rashid
comments.body: syracuse/casablanca i think

comments.author: Francine
comments.body: and rank 8 fishing

comments.author: B~Anne
comments.body:
Can you buy tuna at Zadar? I am assuming so since it shows it above, but it doesn't show a price for it.
I just don't want to invest that much if I can't get it :D
Thank you!

comments.author: B~Anne
comments.body: Never mind, I can't invest in Zadar anyway. lol Thank you!

comments.body:
70k development.
keep waiting till East Asia is out

comments.author: Arlen
comments.body: Anyone know any other good places? I know that island just north of Tripoli is good, Syracuse is pretty good too, but I never tried Casablanca.

comments.author: Carla
comments.body: you can get this on farm with approx 500 productivity

comments.author: Arlen
comments.body: Ok, Casablanca does not seem to have them (I have fishing r17), but they do have plenty of spanish mackeral if you sail away from port a bit.

comments.author: Jafar
comments.body: my farm only produces 8 per day, but i recently lost some productivity points, but i swap to coral for 30 days production,then back till both are full , its worth having it.

comments.author: Erda
comments.body: also i heard south of madeira , and south of cabo verde-pirates

comments.author: Sakura
comments.body: oh also have a high lvl aide on lookout job helps i think

comments.author: Llewelyn
comments.body: there's a sweet spot south-west a bit from Faro, around 15707,3330 or so.

comments.author: Hernan
comments.body: north of madeira is good tuna spot and mako shark too.

comments.author: Enver
comments.body: So...what's the BEST PLACE ?

comments.body: fish market

comments.body: outside syracuse is the best place

comments.body: outside The Azores is well too :D

comments.author: xXSmokerXx
comments.body: it is possible to catch tuna with r7 fishing aswell, although the line will snap alot - my preferred tuna fishing spot is in the corner (far west side of syracruse island), right across from tunis at 490,3236

comments.author: AliBayan
comments.body: An excellent, not far away place, is also a bit west from Madeira; around the 15300 longitude. Careful for sharks though, an awful lot of those there!

comments.author: Lena
comments.body: South of Madeira is a good spot

comments.body: It requires 80.000 development to unlock it in Guam. It won't take so long anymore :)

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Some other fishing coordinates for Tuna, courtesy of our friends in Japan's servers:

16004.3324 Between Ceuta and Malaga
15333.3433 Off Madeira
15470.3410 Same as above, mackerel
15469.3409 same as above
15794.3343 off the coast of Faro
642.3255 Syracuse off the coast (adventurer) Rarely sunfish
552.5800
701.6227
638.5903 Cape Northwest

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Skill/Collect/Fish

comments.author: Taipan
comments.body: The spot just a bit due north of Madeira(you should just be able to see the city if you swing your view south) will, with r20 Fishing and Oxford skills Field Activities 1 & 2 active, get you 4-5 Tuna(mostly 5) or 3-4 Mako Shark or Swordfish or Sunfish or(when you do get any) 8-10 Blue Mackerel or Sardines with each catch.

comments.author: Irmaniac
comments.body: It is impossible if you're coming from other nation to invest in Zadar.

comments.author: luizebas
comments.body:
I heard that the little island to the north of Tripoli (488,3359) was a good spot for Tuna.

With R16+1 Fishing, I got:
163 Tuna
75 Blue Mackrel
34 Mako Shark
7 Sunfish
3 Swordfish

Nice place to grind Fishing+Storage.

comments.author: luizebas
comments.body:
I did some extra tests in order to find the best spot for Tuna. All those numbers are with R16+1 Fishing.

Immediately Outside Syracuse
Tuna: 1620 (26.7%)
Blue Mackrel: 3750 (62%)
Swordfish: 160 (2.6%)
Mako Shark: 360 (5.9%)
Sunfish: 160 (2.6%)

Syracuse Off the Coast (642, 3256)
Tuna: 2390 (31.3%)
Blue Mackrel: 4190 (55%)
Swordfish: 140 (1.8%)
Mako Shark: 790 (10.3%)
Sunfish: 110 (1.4%)

comments.body: 10m investment in Guam needed for tuna to show up
